notes.title: Ai Log Truck Brings Logs. Rough cut mill Update & What's to Come!
notes.notes:
Lets start with the good new!
*Added a make shift clamp on the loader forks.
*operate the loader clamp - Keyboard - hold left shift + Click Rmb or Lmb 
*operate the loader clamp - Controller - Hold LB + Move LeftStick up or down
You now have a place to sell the rough cut planks!
If you own the rough cut saw mill and are at it, And have $500 in the saw mill bank! then you might have locals hauling and selling you logs!
You will need to off log these. and if you off load a log but don't have the money for it. then it should place back on the truck. 
When done unloading the truck you will need to tell the driver to go. I used my voice and it's not great but was more of a test!

I updated some of the ui!
The load lock went back to 2 keys or buttons.

Now The Bad New! :(
I have been getting a ton of crashes with unity3d. 
And I have been reading that unity3d is not so good for open world games.
So The game will no longer be worked on I think for some time. really a dream killer makes me sad. ;(

But I am going to learn C++ Coding and moving over to unreal engine 5! 
That's right! 
Now this is not going to be a walk in the park! 

But!! I am going to try to add in multiplayer too. 

So I have to learn the engine and C++ then I have to rebuild the whole game. 
I looked back in the code to make it better and seen I was working on this game in 2018. 

But with that said if you find something not working well I do my best to do update to fix it. 

Remember this is hobby game I am making so keep that in mind.

Thanks for the support and thank you for the ones that bought the game and believe in me. 
I will do my best to not let you down.

5/8/2022

notes.title: Fuel Hauling and Selling now added! And bug fixes. 2/4/2022 Live Now!
notes.notes:
Added fuel tanker add-on for the semitrailer. Added 2 places to buy fuel to resell it. The closer one, the fuel cost more. So less money for you. The fuel tanks way out cost way less to buy fuel but longer drive!
You sell the fuel by the fuel station where you get fuel at for the trucks and other. Pull the trailer in the maker on side of the  fuel station.  Fixed the save and loading on the semitrailer. So no more flying up on load. 
Upped the speed on the med gear it goes about 50 now. This is needed to pull full tanker load of fuel. you can't pull it in high drive gear. You can but you Roll coal like a boss! = less fuel.
Worked on the load and save times. Worked on in game things too that was not needed. so the game should load a little faster and save faster and be faster.

Added a graphic setting Called I want my pc on fire! it's the best setting.

This is not much of an update but any update is better then some big one that will most likely never happen.

Thanks for playing my game!

Ross Harris

notes.title: Bug Fixes, Added Backhoe Bucket and more!
notes.notes:
Added Invert Y - axis. You can now toggle it on or off, works both in and out of vehicles.
Added and Backhoe back bucket you can now use it to load dirt.
Added Foxy Log Skidder Cage around the windows.
Shortened the arm2 on the backhoe it looks better.
Adjusted the reverse speed on the vehicles.
Added Road to the next update, if you go to far it will reset you back to start point.
Added flip to the vehicles you can flip them back up. 
Fixed the power ui for the magnet from staying on all the time when the magnet is not on the backhoe.

notes.title: HotFix Fuel Tank
notes.notes: The Big Fuel tank will now work. pull close or put the tank close to the vehicle and it will start filling. And worked a little on the skidder. it hangs more real and the trees seems to move a little better.
